standard_prerequisites.name: The construction of the universal map from a space to a sober space, which is a bijection on opens commuting with unions and intersections
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 4961-4968)
standard_prerequisites.use: Transfers quasi-compactness of opens between the space and its sober quotient.

core_obligations: (1): quasi-compactness of an open subset is equivalent to quasi-compactness of the corresponding open of the sober quotient, because pullback is a bijection on opens commuting with unions (proof lines 4960-4968)

(2): that bijection also commutes with intersections, so a basis of quasi-compact opens and quasi-compactness of pairwise intersections transfer, and the quotient is quasi-compact by (1) and sober by construction, hence spectral (proof lines 4969-4976)
(3): the ascending chain condition on opens transfers along the bijection, giving Noetherianity, and (2) gives spectrality (proof lines 4977-4978)
proof_roadmap: c: X → X' 在开集上是双射且与并、交交换 ⇒ U 准紧 ⟺ U' 准紧，得 (1)。
(2)：由上述双射把基与两两交的准紧性搬到 X'，且 X' 由 (1) 准紧、由构造 sober ⇒ 谱空间。
(3)：开集升链条件沿双射转移 ⇒ X' Noetherian，再由 (2) 得 Noetherian 谱空间。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement collects three properties of the universal sober quotient of a topological space: quasi-compactness is preserved; a space with a basis of quasi-compact opens and quasi-compact pairwise intersections has spectral quotient; a Noetherian space has Noetherian spectral quotient (author lemma at source lines 4946-4958, label lemma-Noetherian-goes-to-spectral). The proof (source lines 4960-4979) observes that the universal map induces a bijection on opens commuting with unions and intersections, and transfers each property through it (proof lines 4960-4978). The transfer through the bijection on opens is the content. H3.
